notes: Pine crowns full, halo largely gone, spruce leader clean. Further loops would be diminishing returns; stopped after three improvement cycles beyond v1.

defects.text: Spruce leader now a 6-card upright tuft.
Dark card-edge halo on pine pads mostly gone; faint dark tips remain at the very ends of needle brushes.
Pine limbs end in clumps; stubs thicker.
